title: Seal wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9fb8d4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6f8aa8'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='32' ry='24' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- belly lighter shade -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#c8d8ea'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='74' rx='8' ry='13' fill='#5f7c9c' transform='rotate(-12 20 74)'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='74' rx='8' ry='13' fill='#5f7c9c' transform='rotate(12 80 74)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='26' ry='22' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- snout/muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#d6e2f0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#2b3550'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <g fill='#7f92aa'>
    <circle cx='40' cy='46' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='50' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='46' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='50' r='1'/>
  </g>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='4.2' fill='#1c2540'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='4.2' fill='#1c2540'/>
  <circle cx='41.2' cy='36.8' r='1.4' fill='#eef4fc'/>
  <circle cx='61.2' cy='36.8' r='1.4' fill='#eef4fc'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 55 Q50 58 54 55' stroke='#5a6b85' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M50 6 L38 30 L62 30 Z' fill='#ff5f8f'/>
  <path d='M50 6 L38 30 L50 30 Z' fill='#ff8fae'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <path d='M42.5 20 L57.5 20' stroke='#ffd94d' stroke-width='3'/>
  <path d='M45.5 13 L54.5 13' stroke='#58c4e8' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- hat pom-pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='3.5' fill='#ffd94d'/>
  <!-- hat brim band -->
  <path d='M37 30 Q50 34 63 30' stroke='#58c4e8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
